Click an Events or Officers cell to see the detailed breakdown.
Requirements Met is out of 3 (Members, Events, Officers): 3/3 Full   2/3 Partial   1/3 Minimal   0/3 None
Officers: Met = Chair & Counselor/Advisor both present   Partial = only one present   Not Met = neither present. In the detail panel, required officer chips (Chair, Counselor/Advisor) show red when missing; optional officer chips (Vice Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, Webmaster) show yellow when missing. Event counts include events co-hosted with other OUs, from 2026 onward, excluding cancelled events. Only reported events (post-event report submitted in vTools) count toward the Events requirement; unreported events appear as a "+N unreported" note and in the Events detail panel, but don't count until reported.
